ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: INTRO TO B&W PHOTOGRAPHY: Introduction to the processes of black and white photography, including camera use, film exposure and processing, and enlarged printing. For Unit One and other Living/Learning Community students only or by permission of the instructor. Art and Design minors who wish to take this class should contact the A+D minor advisor Guen Montgomery (montgo@illinois.edu) for an override. This is a second half session course. The first meeting is Tuesday, October 22, 2019.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Unit One or Weston Explorer Program students.
